pr_title: Stop `BackgroundScreenDefault` from reloading beatmap background when already correct

issue_context.title: `BackgroundScreenDefault` regenerates background content unnecessarily
issue_context.body: Internally this class runs a `Next()` function on each revisit to the main menu, for instance. This will recreate content even if the correct content it still loaded.
comments: Also worth noting that previous background screens are kept in memory indefinitely as long as they are in the stack. We may want to look at eventually changing this (or giving them a way to unload if they choose to), because with changes like #13303 this adds a considerable memory usage overhead.

review_comments: This is a weird way to go about this - could implement `IEquatable`. But okay.
